$comment: Machine-readable codebase knowledge graph for agents. Validated by tests/unit/knowledge-graph.test.ts on every test run: files must exist, exports must exist, edges must reference known nodes, and every top-level src/ directory must be owned by exactly one node. Read docs/knowledge-graph/README.md first.

nodes.label: Config & capability gates
nodes.purpose: Single env-parsed config. Every mutation capability is a fail-closed boolean flag read through getConfig(); tests isolate flags via tests/helpers/fillEnvIsolation.ts.

key_files.src/config/env.ts: zod-style env schema; loads repo `.env` as source of truth (override leftover shell vars); flag defaults (all false)

nodes.label: Storage (SQLite + artifacts)
nodes.purpose: SQLite (data/) is the source of truth for application state. Atomic JSON writers for artifacts/. Outcome recorders feed the improvement loop.

nodes.label: Logging & redaction
nodes.purpose: Structured JSON logger; redaction scrubs secrets/PII before anything is persisted or printed.

nodes.label: Queue & state machine
nodes.purpose: Application lifecycle (docs/state-machine.md). ALL status changes go through transitionApplication — never ad-hoc writes. Review items are the human-work queue; advisory items do not freeze an app. Automation runs hold the atomic unattended-submission budget.

nodes.label: Browser sessions & auth
nodes.purpose: The ONLY allowed chromium.launch sites (house rule): serviceSession, loginFlow, fixtureSession. CDP_ATTACH connects to the operator's own Chrome and close() only disconnects — never closes their tabs. Plan v0.5: the same CDP_ATTACH path may reach a REMOTE handoff browser (Browserbase) — cdpPolicy.ts admits a non-loopback endpoint only behind REMOTE_BROWSER_ENABLED, and remoteBrowser.ts is the provider seam (HTTP only; no browser code).

nodes.purpose: Python sidecar (agent/jobright_agent/navigate.py) over stdin/stdout JSON, attached to the operator's CDP Chrome. Node side validates every result: a supported-ATS host is always an acceptable landing place; acceptance is adapter validation + recorded congruence.

nodes.label: ATS adapters
nodes.purpose: One adapter per vendor (greenhouse/lever/ashby/workable/workday) + GENERIC for any https employer form (no flag — operator directive 2026-08-14; trust is provenance). detectAtsFromUrl dispatches vendor-first, generic last. HTML detectAts never returns unsupported for a fillable page — unmatched hosts and form-less SPAs use generic. Shared pre-mutation gate requires trusted host + no login wall + no captcha + form markers + at least one fillable FIELD. greenhouseFillFromPlan/greenhouseVerifyAnswers are vendor-blind despite the filename. Option harvest (2026-08-14) scrapes each control's real answer space from the LIVE page before planning: HTML alone cannot see a React-select's list, so dropdowns used to reach the planner empty and fall through to blind free-text typing.

Email verification codes come from Gmail (web scan) or Outlook providers; secrets ride memory only.

nodes.label: Gmail (readonly + compose, drafts only) & Outlook (drafts-only)
nodes.purpose: Gmail: readonly for verification codes; compose (plan M19, decision 2026-09-11) ONLY to create drafts in a hosted user's own mailbox — readonlyGuards.ts pins the two scopes and bans every send endpoint (messages and drafts, dotted and slashed) + the send/modify scopes, enforced by scripts/check-forbidden.ts; draftsApi.ts admits exactly POST users/me/drafts + GET users/me/drafts/{id} per request and reports a draft only after a DRAFT-label read-back. Outlook creates DRAFTS only — sendGuards.ts is its banned-identifier source. Mail is never sent by this system.

nodes.label: Pipeline driver
nodes.purpose: runPipeline steps ONE application through the state machine: materials -> navigation -> ATS detection -> inspection -> fill -> submit, stopping on review/terminal/gate. Every stop writes a review item or a state reason. Halt check ignores advisory review items. Fill with no stored employer URL and NAVIGATION_ENABLED returns to APPLICATION_OPENING instead of parking.

nodes.label: Operator console

Confirmation seam for one-shot submits. Local security (security.ts: loopback Host pin + per-boot token) is untouched; CONSOLE_HOSTED_MODE_ENABLED swaps in hostedAuth.ts (hostname allowlist + Supabase JWT on every /api request + allowlisted user ids + read-only) and is the only way the console may bind a public interface.

nodes.label: Employer sandbox
nodes.purpose: A fake employer on the operator's OWN machine (loopback only), driven by the real pipeline with the operator's real presets. /gauntlet = weird-questions application (predictive tiers, incl. odd questions from live artifacts in both CLOSED and OPEN classes); /portal = posting → email/password wall → form (posting advance + portalAuth account creation/sign-in). Page hits, fill-plan lines (with model rationale via POST /trace), and received submissions echo to the sandbox terminal + artifacts/sandbox/. Generic URL validation and portal-auth host recognition carry narrow loopback-only allowances so ats:fill --url http://localhost:4599/… drives it. ats:fill --submit is loopback-only and still requires SUBMIT_ENABLED + confirmation. 2026-08-16: /portal gained an emailed-code wall (random 6-digit per issue, newest wins) so the Gmail mailbox-scan recovery rehearses end to end; /navhard and /fillhard re-create the exact obstacles live artifacts show the nav and fill systems struggling with.

nodes.label: LLM failure triage
nodes.purpose: After a run fails, the LLM chooses ONE remediation from an enumerated action set (requeue / reopen navigation / park / abandon / engage agent leg). Every choice is re-validated deterministically (verbatim set membership, forbidden signature history, state-machine preconditions) and executed only through existing legal primitives with hard caps; the read-back sweep confirms or refutes decisions from application_events. Retry-differently: a (signature, action) pair is never repeated.

key_files.src/triage/actions.ts: TRIAGE_ACTIONS enum + per-action preconditions + executors over existing primitives
key_files.src/triage/triageLlm.ts: prompt + parse + verbatim validation ladder (invalid => no_action)

nodes.label: Tenant workspaces (multi-tenant engine)
nodes.purpose: Plan v0.5: one engine process per HOSTED user, in a workspace the process derives from the tenant's uuid (private/tenants/<uuid>/ — their profile, documents, sealed sessions, their OWN SQLite, artifacts, runs). Secrets are AES-GCM under a per-tenant key: HKDF-SHA256 of one DPAPI-wrapped master with the uuid as salt, reached through the candidate crypto seam (CANDIDATE_KEY_PROVIDER=tenant in the child env). Plaintext a run needs exists only under private/unsealed/ and is wiped when the run ends. The materializer (src/cloud/tenantMaterializer.ts, pure) turns cloud rows into the engine's own files and workspace.ts writes them (tenant:materialize / tenant:status). tenant:run (run.ts) does one job for one tenant: gate → materialize → quota budget (cloud user_quota_status minus local completions not yet mirrored) → sealed JobRight state or a jobright_connect handoff → unseal → spawn auto:cycle as a child whose env is the console flag ceiling narrowed further (childEnv.ts: forced-offs, stripped secrets, workspace paths, tenant key provider) → wipe every plaintext → sync the tenant's own rows → derive handoffs from its review items → result.json → complete_engine_job. tenant:scheduler (scheduler.ts) is the bounded loop over the cloud queue: reap → handoff poller (requested JobRight tasks provisioned on the remote browser, stale live ones expired, user_done ⇒ a reconnect_verify job) → planner (connected + quota + not paused + no blocking handoff + no active/recent apply ⇒ one apply job, ≤5 per tick) → lease ≤ TENANT_MAX_CONCURRENT and run each through runTenantJob. Every cloud read/write sits behind the SchedulerIo seam.

flags.$comment: Capability flags. ALL default false (fail-closed); enabled in the operator's `.env` for a guarded run. The console ceiling (src/console/flagCeiling.ts) can only narrow, never widen.
flags.DRY_RUN: true = describe, never mutate (must be false to fill live)
flags.SUBMIT_ENABLED: the submit click (plus approved plan entry + confirmation/arm)
flags.NAVIGATION_ENABLED: click Apply on JobRight, portal auth, employer navigation
flags.CDP_AUTOLAUNCH_ENABLED: self-start the debug Chrome when :9222 is down
flags.GMAIL_VERIFICATION_ENABLED: read-only Gmail scan for verification codes
flags.OUTLOOK_DRAFTS_ENABLED: create Outlook drafts (send is impossible by construction)
flags.GMAIL_DRAFTS_ENABLED: create Gmail drafts via the signed-in web session (Send is a forbidden selector, never clicked)
flags.SCREENER_LLM_MATCH_ENABLED: LLM places a HELD answer onto the page's own option list (verbatim-validated)
flags.SCREENER_PREDICT_LLM_ENABLED: plan-time screener prediction (fills + remembers custom bank entries; EEO excluded)
flags.ESSAY_AUTOFILL_ENABLED: essays generated from about-me.md fill directly (also unlocked by SCREENER_PREDICT_LLM_ENABLED; validateDraft-checked, recorded on the plan)
flags.ARTIFACT_AUTOPUSH_ENABLED: git-push run artifacts for the improvement loop
flags.ATS_DISCOVERY_ENABLED: Enqueue from public ATS board APIs (creates jobs + applications). Fail closed.
flags.SUPABASE_SYNC_ENABLED: One-way aggregate status mirror to Supabase (cloud plane; requires SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY + SUPABASE_SYNC_USER_ID). Also gates cloud:schema apply (DDL), invites:mint --load, and invites:roundtrip. Fail closed.
flags.CONSOLE_HOSTED_MODE_ENABLED: Console may bind a public interface: hostname allowlist + Supabase JWT (JWKS-verified) on EVERY /api request + allowlisted user ids + read-only. Off = local model byte-for-byte. Requires SUPABASE_URL + CONSOLE_HOSTED_ALLOWED_HOSTS + CONSOLE_HOSTED_ALLOWED_USER_IDS or refuses to boot.
flags.TRIAGE_LLM_ENABLED: LLM failure triage may decide + record remediations (enumerated action set, deterministically validated). Decide-only without TRIAGE_ACT_ENABLED. Fail closed.
flags.TRIAGE_ACT_ENABLED: Triage may EXECUTE validated decisions through existing state-machine primitives (abandon class promoted 2026-09-06 after the read-back sweep validated live; executors keep evidence preconditions + abandonApplication's edge guard). Inert without TRIAGE_LLM_ENABLED. Fail closed.
flags.NAV_LLM_ASSIST_ENABLED: Navigation LLM assist: promote ONE already-harvested apply candidate when both deterministic phases miss (verbatim set membership; every downstream gate unchanged), and record same-job/different-job evidence on duplicate parks (verdicts never unblock). Fail closed.
flags.TENANT_ENGINE_ENABLED: Multi-tenant engine (plan v0.5): materialize a HOSTED user's workspace under TENANTS_ROOT and run auto:cycle for them as a child whose flags are the ceiling ∩ the tenant's own (autopush / agent fallback / CDP autolaunch / Outlook / triage-act / ATS discovery forced off; portal password + access token stripped). Requires SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY or refuses to boot; tenants carry their own ids. Fail closed.
flags.REMOTE_BROWSER_ENABLED: The engine may attach over CDP to a NON-loopback browser — the remote session a hosted user drives during a JobRight sign-in handoff (src/auth/cdpPolicy.ts). Off: only 127.0.0.1 CDP URLs are accepted anywhere. Requires BROWSERBASE_API_KEY + BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID (secrets) or refuses to boot. Fail closed.

invariants: Every mutation capability is behind a fail-closed env flag; never defaulted on, never enabled in tests.
Form values come only from the approved plan (assertExecutableApprovedEntry is never weakened).
Demographics fill ONLY from the operator's encrypted sensitive profile; nothing inferred.
Mail is never sent: Outlook drafts only; sendGuards + check:forbidden enforce it.
State transitions only via the state machine; SQLite is the source of truth.
Selectors live in versioned registries, not inline.
Congruence (hostname vs company) is recorded evidence, never a proceed/stop gate (operator directive 2026-08-14).
The generic adapter has no flag: any https non-vendor employer form is fillable; mutation still behind the fill flags.
An agent's self-report carries no validation level until independently verified (validation ladder).
